summary: This bill requires the Secretary of Agriculture to establish and recognize agricultural research centers of excellence across various focus areas and creates a grant program to fund research, extension, and education activities aimed at protecting the U.S. food and agricultural system from various threats.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly authorizes appropriations of $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 for two separate programs: the Centers of Excellence and the Agriculture and Food Protection Grant Program. This direct authorization of new spending makes government spending a central aspect of the bill.
